_comment: Cross-platform ephemeral-mode parity contract. Consumed IDENTICALLY by iOS (agent-ios/Tests/.../EphemeralContractParityTests.swift) and Android (agent-android/.../EphemeralContractParityTest.kt). It is the single oracle that keeps the two clients consistent: editing it forces both platforms to update together. See agent/docs/ephemeral-security-validation-plan.md (Layer B).

scenarios.name: history_resend_grows_each_turn
scenarios.description: Across 3 turns in one ephemeral conversation, the client must (a) send ephemeral:true every turn, (b) re-send the full local history each turn (2N-1 messages on turn N), (c) send NO conversationId on turn 1, then reuse the server-returned id, and (d) never fetch history from the server.

scenarios.name: private_only_flag_forwarded
scenarios.description: When the consuming app marks the client private_only, every run carries private_only:true so the server can fail-close egress to the configured private (Modal) endpoint. Server-side enforcement is covered by test_sovereignty.py; this only asserts the clients forward the flag identically.
